Core.name: The Core
Core.environment: Bright, ordered civic, Admiralty, archive, and Fleet command environments with polished stone, etched metal, and disciplined infrastructure.
Core.tone: Ceremonial confidence under growing political strain.
Core.political: Fleet and Crown authority, doctrine, remembrance, and institutional legitimacy.

Verge.name: The Verge
Verge.environment: Frontier docks, markets, farms, freeports, patched textiles, working ships, crowded civilian infrastructure.
Verge.tone: Lived-in pragmatism, scarcity, trade pressure, and stubborn independence.
Verge.political: Civil government, traders, escorts, and local communities bargaining for survival.

Shards.name: The Shards
Shards.environment: Salvage cities, scarred decks, warrens, debris corridors, war halls, improvised engineering, and patched armor.
Shards.tone: Hard survival, factional rivalry, anger, and emerging solidarity.
Shards.political: Warlords, captains, raiders, blocs, and the Silent Triarch compete for legitimacy.

Lattice.name: The Lattice
Lattice.environment: Anomaly corridors, echo space, crystalline structures, survey stations, and regions where geometry and timing become unreliable.
Lattice.tone: Scientific awe mixed with existential risk.
Lattice.political: Exploration and technical necessity force cross-faction cooperation.

Corridors.name: Inter-faction Corridors
Corridors.environment: Rifts, gates, convoy lanes, orbit, docking approaches, and transit space connecting Core, Verge, Shards, and Lattice.
Corridors.tone: Movement under threat; protection, piracy, and fragile cooperation.
Corridors.political: Control of passage determines food, legitimacy, and survival.
